tests.command: TMPDIR=/workspace/.phorvex-test-tmp /workspace/.phorvex-workflow-venv/bin/python -m unittest benchmark.stage.test_evidence benchmark.stage.test_observe benchmark.stage.test_storage benchmark.worker.test_endpoint_refresh -v

findings: Explicit immutable zlib-v1 encoding and actual encoded quota preserve the canonical decoded scope/event/order/time hash chain and separate verified decoded/encoded counters.
Decoder enforces hard encoded/decoded sizes, exactly one complete stream, strict UTF-8 canonical JSON and no unbounded flush; malformed/corrupt/counter mismatch cases fail closed.
Both counters and each event commit atomically; concurrent writer clocks and rollback on a failed counter update have executable controls.
Old plain journal bytes and metadata remain unchanged on open; format/capacity changes are refused, and uncached ancient journals are readable without implicit migration.
Free-space checks use the journal filesystem with the existing four-GiB reserve, bounded scans fail without completeness claims, and status reports physical DB/WAL plus labelled estimates.
Persistent service example now names a NEW compressed journal and explicitly passes --encoding zlib-v1 --max-bytes 4294967296.

Reviewer independently re-encoded all 1,079 actual historical control events, performed an SQLite backup while open, reopened and verified exact records/chain/counters, and matched every event-clock reducer state. Physical backup is 2,916,352 bytes; original evidence is unchanged.
limitations: This verdict accepts lossless bounded storage for a newly started source-bound stage segment; it cannot connect the old control journal to a new source/session.
No actual 30-day history or continuity exists. Same-rate physical SQLite projection is about 4.106 GB plus WAL; actual host reserve/cache/generation headroom must be maintained.

At the measured rate and scan cost, a 30-day full pass projects about 18 minutes; current multi-pass refresh within its <=1,800-second total timeout does not establish original-30d operational readiness.
Actual fresh ef94 journal/capture/baseline/bot acceptance and final integrated source checks remain pending.
